slides.heading: Picture Profiles
slides.subheading: Choose profiles based on grading needs — not habit.

slides.heading: Why It Matters
bullets: Picture profiles define the look of your footage in‑camera.
They matter because they affect contrast, color, and dynamic range.
Standard profiles look finished but limit grading.

slides.heading: Visual Guide
slides.caption: Standard profiles look finished but limit grading.

slides.heading: How To
steps: Expose Log brighter to avoid noise.

slides.heading: Pro Tip
slides.text: Use Log only when you plan to grade intentionally.

slides.heading: Common Mistake
slides.text: Underexposing Log and creating noisy shadows.
